scale.extension: Add comparison anchors in a new rubric version; preserve earlier versions. Every rated level requires an anchor registered for that axis and version.

conditions: Reference miniatures use four bars, quarter-note BPM 80 and 4/4 unless stated. They are comparison anchors, never mandatory assignments.
rules: Levels order registered comparison anchors within an axis. Initial anchors 1–3 do not define low/medium/high or a highest possible musical demand. Never sum levels or assume equal intervals.
Compare to anchors at the assigned BPM. Explain tempo differences and combined demands; do not treat note count as difficulty.
Use unknown when instructions are insufficient, not_applicable when absent, out_of_range when anchors cannot support a rating.
An anchor is a provisional design hypothesis, not a validated international grade. Preserve assigned ratings; personal predictions are separate.
Whole-task labels cannot identify the difficult axis. Good means useful, not medium difficulty. No performance probability or ability score.

The interface shows task characteristics and the personal burden forecast, not internal levels or anchor comparisons. Keep level comparisons out of exercise descriptions and personal forecast explanations.

melody.label: Melody and patterns
melody.guidance: Compare pitch motion and pattern changes; tempo and fingering are separate conditions.

anchors.exercise: Repeat C4-D4-E4-D4 in quarter notes for four bars; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Small repeated stepwise pattern.

anchors.exercise: Quarter notes C4-E4-G4-E4 | D4-F4-A4-F4 | E4-G4-B4-G4 | C4-E4-G4-C5; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Changing arpeggio shapes within an octave.

anchors.exercise: Quarter notes C4-C5-E4-B4 | D4-A4-F4-D5 | E4-C5-G4-E5 | C4-G4-D5-C5; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Frequent large leaps and changing patterns.

rhythm.label: Rhythm
rhythm.guidance: Compare onset/rest structure independently of pitch, accent and familiarity.

anchors.exercise: Repeat C4 on each quarter beat for four bars; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Regular on-beat quarter notes.

anchors.exercise: Repeat C4 in continuous even eighth notes for four bars; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Regular eighth-note subdivision.

anchors.exercise: On C4, eighth notes/rests: bar 1 rest-note-note-rest-note-note-rest-note; bar 2 note-rest-note-note-rest-note-note-rest; repeat these two bars. LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Changing eighth-rest patterns and offbeat entries.

meter.label: Meter and grouping
meter.guidance: The current renderer supports 4/4 only. Other meters are comparison references, not permission to render unsupported scores.

anchors.exercise: Four bars of 4/4: C4 quarter notes with a regular four-beat grouping; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Stable simple meter and grouping.

anchors.exercise: Four bars of 6/8: C4 eighth notes grouped 3+3, dotted-quarter pulse 80; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Stable compound meter; outside notation v1.

anchors.exercise: Alternate 5/8 grouped 3+2 and 7/8 grouped 2+2+3, eighth-note pulse 160, four bars on C4; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Changing uneven groupings; outside notation v1.

tonality.label: Tonality
tonality.guidance: Count changes in tonal reference, not sharps/flats as universal physical difficulty. Familiarity belongs to personal prediction.

anchors.exercise: C major throughout: C4-D4-E4-G4 in quarter notes, repeat four bars; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: One stable diatonic tonal reference in any key.

anchors.exercise: C major: C4-D4-D#4-E4 | G4-F4-F#4-G4, quarter notes, repeat; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Chromatic approaches within a stable tonal reference.

anchors.exercise: Quarter-note broken triads, one key per bar: C4-E4-G4-C5 | Eb4-G4-Bb4-Eb5 | F#4-A#4-C#5-F#5 | A4-C#5-E5-A5; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Repeated shifts of tonal reference.

harmony.label: Harmony and voicing
harmony.guidance: Compare simultaneous voices, chord function and voice movement; hand span facts do not imply a feasible fingering.

anchors.exercise: RH whole-note triads C4+E4+G4 | F4+A4+C5 | G4+B4+D5 | C4+E4+G4; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Simple triads or single-note harmonic roles.

anchors.exercise: RH whole-note guide tones F3+C4 | F3+B3 | E3+B3 | E3+B3 over Dm7-G7-Cmaj7-Cmaj7; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Guide-tone voice leading through changing seventh-chord functions.

anchors.exercise: RH whole-note voicings F3+A3+C4+E4 | F3+Ab3+B3+Eb4 | E3+G3+B3+D4 | E3+G3+A3+D4 over Dm9-G7alt-Cmaj9-C6/9; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Extensions/alterations and several moving voices; chord symbols describe the intended function.

expression.label: Accents and expression
expression.guidance: Assess only explicitly requested expression. Plain notation alone does not establish a demand.

anchors.exercise: C4 quarter notes for four bars, even mezzo-forte and consistent articulation; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: One consistent dynamic and articulation.

anchors.exercise: Same C4 quarter notes, accent beat 2 lightly in every bar, keep other notes even; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: One repeated displaced accent instruction.

anchors.exercise: Same C4 quarter notes; alternate accent positions 2 and 4 between bars, crescendo across two bars then diminuendo, keep notes legato; LH rests.
anchors.comparison: Several explicitly independent expression instructions.

coordination.label: Hand coordination
coordination.guidance: Assess combined roles; do not sum individual hand ratings.

anchors.exercise: Both hands play whole notes together: LH C3, RH E4, repeat four bars.
anchors.comparison: Shared attacks and releases, or a single active hand.

anchors.exercise: LH holds C3 whole notes; RH C4-D4-E4-D4 quarter notes in each of four bars.
anchors.comparison: Steady support against a distinct moving part.

anchors.exercise: LH plays C3 on beats 1 and 3 as quarter notes with quarter rests on 2 and 4; RH plays C4 on every eighth-note offbeat with eighth rests on each beat, four bars.
anchors.comparison: Independent, interlocking attacks between hands.
